purpose: The final owner-facing handoff that records the selected result or an explicit prepared/no-delivery outcome.
rules: PREPARED_NO_DELIVERY is valid only for the explicit PREPARED owner choice.
SELECTED_RESULT requires acceptance evidence, action evidence, and the prepared adapter contract for every external outcome; DEPLOY and RELEASE also require live-audit evidence.
Risk, deferred, and next-action fields use safe codes rather than free-form private text.
